about.title: About
about.description: {{highlight}}3C{{/highlight}} is the leading coding school for kids aged 6 to 18 in Egypt and the Middle East. Accredited by STEM.org and ISO certified, 3C has trained over 100,000 students across 22 countries. We teach real, text-based programming from day one using fun, intuitive, and gamified methods that make learning smooth and enjoyable.
